method: Manual read-only relevant complete native functions inspected, no compilation/execution/copies/helpers. Conclusions/hashes only.
conclusions: SystemWindow PreNotify Ctrl-F6 without Shift grabs its document client and returns handled; additional Alt/Mod3 are not excluded by this condition. Other F6 variants continue task-pane routing.
Window GrabFocusToDocument delegates; ImplGrabFocusToDocument climbs own frame and grabs client, while ImplGrabFocus rejects disabled/input-disabled/modal/disposed client and sends old LoseFocus.
MenuBarWindow LoseFocus invalidates highlight with restore disabled, killing current popup and consuming saved owner. Explicit direct document focus wins over saved toolbar owner.
Native menu/popup Ctrl-F6 cleanup and TaskPaneList confirm document shortcut ownership distinct from command Execute; browser frame owns route and existing DOM menubar blur owns teardown.

Mounted Writer editor maps frame client. Shared active/modal eligibility keeps blocked Writer client untouched. Full plain/Shift-F6 pane cycle/platform modifier mapping/native flags/focus graph remain unverified.
